title: Crews of Lancasters ME625 and ND981
memorial_details:
description: Commemorative display of salvaged aircraft wreckage with associated memorial plaque.
The plaque is mounted on a back board within a display case of the remains of the two aircraft, it has a colour badge of 97 Squadron RAF at top centre, and either side are lightly etched depictions of two Lancaster aircraft. The inscription is below with names in two columns by aircraft crew, all etched and in white. 
Beneath the plaque is a small information panel with brief details of the plaques origin.
